citation.this_register: cite the register by its task id and the commit it was generated at, which the run manifest in artifacts/b2-4 records
citation.why: citing only the collection drops the groups whose experiments the analysis rests on, and citing only the studies loses the pinned release a result regenerates from

coverage.note: every assay is covered by the deposit's grant, which is what this project relies on. The article-terms breakdown describes the source publications and is carried for the reader, not as a constraint this project is operating under

limits: MIT is a software licence. Applying it to a data deposit is ordinary practice on Zenodo and it is the maintainers' own stated choice, but its effect on data is less settled than on code. Recorded as the grant relied on, not as a legal conclusion
the deposit's grant is the maintainers'. It does not reach back and relicense the studies that produced the assays, which is why each study's own terms are carried per assay below

not_published_by_this_project: the measured fitness values themselves — the assay data stays in the pinned release and is read from it, never re-hosted here
the benchmark's own published model scores, which are read from the pinned release for the reference check and reported only as an agreement statistic
published_by_this_project: assay identifiers, organism and taxonomy, family and order, and the arm each assay falls in under each reading of each filter policy
per-assay counts: variants and sequence length, as the pinned release states them
the DOI of the study that produced each assay
scores this project computed, per variant and per assay, and the rank correlations derived from them
redistribution.why_it_matters: a register of metadata and of this project's own numbers is publishable under the deposit's grant whatever each source article's terms say. The source terms are carried anyway, because a reader going back to an assay needs them

what_this_is: the provenance and licence register for every assay Phase B analyses. Generated by tools/assay_register.py from B2.2's curation, B2.3's control set and the licence evidence in assays/licences.json. Do not hand-edit
